items.title: Corning Stock Sank 46% in July. Why Wall Street Says It Could Be a Buy Right Now.
items.summary: Shares of  Corning  had a tough July but a Truist analyst team believes the stock now has a “more reasonable entry point.”  Shares of the optical networking company gained 6.5% to $147.30 on Monday after ending Friday up 2.2%.
